name: wp-referrer-canonical-source-name
description: [PLUGIN BEHAVIOR] Search-referrer classification writes CANONICAL source names ('google', 'bing'), not the referrer host. Engine writes the full referrer host ('google.com').
quirk_decision: DISAGREEMENT: plugin ft_source='google' via SEARCH_REFERRER_RULES (clicutcl-attribution.js:66-74,267-291); engine ft_source='google.com' (host passthrough). Conflicts with golden organic-search-referrer.
